title: Booking a Trip with a Travel Agent

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to plan and book trips
vocabulary.example: I booked my trip with a travel agent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: days when you don't go to work
vocabulary.example: I have some time off next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time of rest away from work or school
a small book with pictures and information
of very good quality and usually expensive
arranging a room, seat or ticket before
vocabulary.example: Would you like me to make the booking?

vocabulary.meaning_en: facts about you, like your name and number

vocabulary.example: You can reach me at this number.
I need a return flight on the 31st.

vocabulary.meaning_en: whether something is free to use or buy

vocabulary.example: There is a layover in Hong Kong.
I was hoping for a direct flight.
It arrives at 2:30 pm local time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel room for one person
vocabulary.example: A single room will be fine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel room for two people
vocabulary.example: Do you prefer a single or a double room?

fine_lines.title: direct flight vs layover
fine_lines.explanation_ar: direct flight = بدون توقف. layover = توقف في مدينة أخرى قبل الوصول.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A direct flight has no stops. A layover is a stop in another city on the way.

examples.sentence: There is a three-hour layover in Dubai.

fine_lines.title: depart vs arrive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: depart = يغادر (يبدأ الرحلة). arrive = يصل (نهاية الرحلة). نقول arrive in + مدينة، arrive at + مكان.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Depart" = leave. "Arrive" = reach. Say "arrive in" a city, "arrive at" a place.

examples.sentence: It arrives in Tokyo at 2:30 pm.

expressions.phrase: How can I assist you today?
expressions.example: Good morning, how can I assist you today?

expressions.phrase: I was thinking of visiting Tokyo.
expressions.example: I was thinking of visiting my aunt.
How long is your holiday? Two weeks.

expressions.phrase: Take a look and see if there's a hotel that you like.
expressions.meaning_ar: ألقِ نظرة وانظر إن كان هناك فندق يعجبك.
expressions.example: Take a look at the menu.

expressions.phrase: Would you like me to make the booking now?
expressions.example: Would you like me to book a taxi?
You can reach me at this number during the day.

expressions.phrase: Will you be traveling alone? / Yes, it will be just me.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل ستسافر وحدك؟ / نعم، أنا فقط.
expressions.example: Will you be traveling alone? No, with my family.
The flight has one stop. Is that acceptable to you?

expressions.phrase: I was hoping for a direct flight.
expressions.meaning_en: Politely saying you wanted something else.
expressions.example: I was hoping for a window seat.
A direct flight? That sounds much better.

expressions.meaning_en: A kind goodbye to a traveller.
expressions.example: Have a wonderful trip to Paris!

grammar.title: Shall I ...? (offers)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم Shall I + فعل لنعرض أن نفعل شيئًا بأدب.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "Shall I + verb?" to offer to do something politely.
examples: Shall I book your flight for the next day?
Shall I call you at work?

grammar.title: Dates: on the 24th of December
grammar.explanation_ar: نقول on مع التاريخ واليوم: on the 24th of December / on Friday.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "on" with dates and days: on the 24th of December, on Friday.
examples: My last day at work is on the 24th of December.
